description: Angular component for managing MobileApp entities in the Thingsboard platform, including form building, validation, and UI interactions.

classes.name: MobileAppComponent
classes.description: Angular component for creating, editing, and displaying MobileApp entities with form validation and UI controls.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs a reactive form for MobileApp entity with validation rules.

methods.name: updateForm
methods.description: Patches the form with entity data.

methods.name: updateFormState
methods.description: Updates the form's state, disables/enables controls based on context.

methods.name: prepareFormValue
methods.description: Prepares and returns the form data for submission.

methods.name: generateAppSecret
methods.description: Generates a new app secret and updates the form.

methods.name: editReleaseNote
methods.description: Opens a popover editor for release notes, updates form upon completion.

methods.name: base64Format
methods.description: Validator to check if a string is valid base64 and meets length requirements.
